limitations_and_corrections.subject: Valuation date
limitations_and_corrections.finding: June 30 capital/discount origin with information through October 18, 2026. Ten full years end June 2036, end-year discounting. This is a retrospective-information analytical DCF, not an October 18 equity fair value or point-in-time June thesis.

limitations_and_corrections.subject: Convertible and claims
limitations_and_corrections.finding: 650 full convertible claim, 5.324 finance lease, 25 residual claims, 2 legacy option claim and 0.85m RSUs remain illustrative. No fixed claim is independently certified. Full-note deduction and no extra face/conversion-share addition is arithmetically coherent; common allocation requires contract-aware scenario repricing and same-date claims.

limitations_and_corrections.subject: Old notes and operating-capital claims
limitations_and_corrections.finding: June carrying balance is consistent with only 2030 notes but cannot prove old-note settlement composition. Full interim cash flow, gross awards, leases, opening tax/acquisition/capital payables remain unresolved. This does not block dated operating EV or explicitly editable conditional allocation.

limitations_and_corrections.subject: Historical depreciation
limitations_and_corrections.finding: Annual note/depreciation comparisons and 2023 cash-flow D&A do not fully reconcile; lease ROU is included in annual PPE. Do not convert this history into clean physical D&A or normalized historical ROIC. Forecast depreciation 1.7% is explicit and independent.

limitations_and_corrections.subject: Visual Layer timing
limitations_and_corrections.finding: Replace acquired in April 2026 with acquisition announced April 14 and closed by May 12. No effect on the June-origin bridge; acquisition cash is already embedded.

limitations_and_corrections.subject: Terminal and funding economics
limitations_and_corrections.finding: Terminal values contribute 51.9%/60.3%/66.2% of EV. Years 6–9 blend marginal-sales funding with terminal-growth reinvestment and retain a cash floor; this is an explicit policy, not demonstrated constant historical ROIC. Terminal investment covers the modeled floor and year-10 cash-flow continuity passes.

limitations_and_corrections.subject: Discount inputs
limitations_and_corrections.finding: Monthly ERP, October 16 yield and January sector beta are deliberately mixed-date estimates. Debt weight 5%, Treasury spread 175bp and mature levered beta 1.15 are analyst assumptions. Verified inputs do not make them issuer-observed costs of capital.

limitations_and_corrections.subject: History audit scope
limitations_and_corrections.finding: 289 populated historical facts match frozen SEC companyfacts and scales; all ten diluted share counts match printed statements. This is source linkage and arithmetic testing, not a statutory audit or independent certification of every issuer disclosure. Early continuing CFO and potentially total-business capex remain non-comparable.

reproducibility: Run python independent-audit-v1.py. Standard library only. Does not execute or alter source builders, v1 inputs, public-safe bundle or Site. Source web checks dated 2026-10-18 are not refreshed by script rerun.
